name: Do I need to close my practice during a medical office renovation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to close my practice during a medical office renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you need to close your practice during a renovation depends on the project's scope and how it's managed. For minor updates, partial closures or off-hours work might be sufficient. Larger projects, especially those involving significant structural changes or utility shutdowns, may require temporary relocation or full closure for a period. A well-planned renovation strategy often includes phased construction to minimize disruption, allowing some services to continue. Discussing operational continuity with your contractor early in the planning process is important.
acceptedAnswer.description: Closing depends on project scope; minor updates may allow partial operation, while extensive renovations might require temporary closure. Phased construction can help minimize disruption.
